comments.author: @frontiermadeco
comments.text: Building on ground that never thaws changes everything, from pipes to foundations. How do homes there keep the permafrost from melting under them?

comments.author: @lifeonearth68
comments.text: They actually have to keep their houses off the ground so the heat doesn't melt the frozen soil underneath? That's something I never would've thought about. Anyone from Utqiagvik know how much harder that makes building a home? 🤔🤔

comments.author: @lifeonearth68
comments.text: I've heard of frozen pipes in winter, but having to build an entire system just to keep water flowing in the Arctic is another level. I wonder how much maintenance those pipes need every year.
